name: Utility-aware memory retrieval preregistration v1
common_protocol: First-present-frame ground-truth mask, forward propagation, no corrections.

primary_model.name: SAM 2.1 Hiera-S
primary_model.checkpoint_policy: One fixed checkpoint for SAM2.1, SAM2Long, Lean-SAM2 and the utility head.

utility.definition: Dice loss with unit excluded minus baseline Dice loss, equivalent to baseline Dice minus excluded Dice
utility.random_null: best of N random exclusion sets of matched size, where N is the number of leave-one-out evaluations

evidence_bars.E3_corruption_trend: monotonic decrease in attention-utility agreement and significantly lower agreement for predicted than GT memory
evidence_bars.E5_probe: paired sequence-level improvement over the best of attention, similarity and confidence
evidence_bars.E6: Holm-corrected paired sequence-level gain on failure frames, with no meaningful loss on success frames

statistics.unit: DAVIS sequence-object pair or PolypGen sequence

sanity_checks.davis_reference: Compare against facebookresearch/sam2 commit 2b90b9f5ceec907a1c18123530e92e794ad901a4 with the identical SAM2.1 checkpoint and first-frame masks; require J&F within 1 point. No hard-coded published number is assumed.
sanity_checks.empty_exclusion_mask: Maximum absolute logit difference must be zero.
sanity_checks.cached_state_restore: Rerunning a frame from the retained state must reproduce the baseline logits exactly.
sanity_checks.attention_reconstruction: Reconstructed projected/RoPE QK-softmax-V output maximum absolute error must be below 1e-5.

davis_2017.selection_rule: No threshold, checkpoint or hyperparameter is selected on validation.

polypgen.use: test only for the utility-aware experiment; empty-ground-truth sequences contribute only false-positive metrics

decision_rules.E2_below_bar: Cancel the method branch and frame the paper around the dominant failure cause.
decision_rules.E5_fails: Skip E6 utility-head training; report E1-E4 as a diagnostic study.
decision_rules.E6_matches_finetuned_attention: Claim exposure-bias mechanism and the corrupted-rollout training recipe, not unique utility supervision.
decision_rules.existing_criterion_near_oracle: Narrow the novelty claim and report that criterion as the practical method.
